q2_gaps: optative / well-wishing imperatives ("Have fun", "Get well soon", "Enjoy!") — the Imperatives section routes every imperative to Directive / Forbid as a command, with no way to record that the speaker wishes rather than orders the eventuality

light-verb constructions over an abstract object noun ("have fun", "take a look", "make a decision") — the light-verb rule covers only occur / happen / take place over event-denoting nouns, and the idiom rule fires only when the literal reading is incoherent, so a semi-literal light verb falls between the two and it is undecided whether to fuse (have_fun) or decompose

vague / relative temporal adverbs ("soon", "shortly", "later") — the deictic-constant inventory is an enumerated list (yesterday / today / tonight / this_morning / last_week / next_summer …) that does not reach them, so putting soon on Time as a bare constant is an extrapolation
notes: The coordinated imperatives are correctly translated as two independent Directive seals with no addressee referent minted and no tense asserted, and come_back is kept whole as a particle verb with no genus, per the phrasal-verb rule.
